newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - March 10.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - March 10.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Pilgrims to sacrifice 500,000 sheep during this year's annual pilgrimage in April.
- The Pakistani embassy hopes to raise $300 million from Pakistanis living in Saudi Arabia to support Pakistan's debt scheme.
- The Riyadh Chamber of Commerce and Industry decides to set up an arbitration committee to handle the growing number of technical disputes.
- Saudi Industrial Development Fund to extend loans worth 192 million riyals to set up five new industrial projects.
- Tunisian team visiting Saudi Arabia offers investment opportunities worth $1.4 billion.
- Shareholders of al-Rajhi Banking and Investment plan to propose a rise in the bank's paid-in capital.
